title: Exit Skills
text: Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:
items: Design software solutions using algorithmic problem-solving methodologies.
Develop, test, debug, and document Python programs.
Apply structured and modular programming techniques.
Design and implement object-oriented software solutions.
Utilize Python collection data types, file input/output, and exception handling to solve programming problems.
Apply software engineering principles including readability, maintainability, testing, and documentation.
Evaluate software solutions for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.
Develop complete software applications that satisfy stated requirements.
